title: Melanoma genome sequencing reveals frequent PREX2 mutations
central_claims: Melanoma genomes contain recurrent PREX2 mutations.
Selected mutant PREX2 alleles accelerate tumor formation in NRAS-mutant human melanocyte xenografts.

source_manifest.title: Replication Study: Melanoma genome sequencing reveals frequent PREX2 mutations
source_manifest.finding: No significant mutant/control tumor-free-survival difference; unexpectedly rapid tumors in all controls confounded acceleration test.

source_manifest.title: Somatic mutations of PREX2 gene in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma
source_manifest.finding: Independent HCC study followed the PREX2 mutation lead, identifying S1113R-mediated stability and migration changes; different cancer and allele.

research.summary: Direct melanoma replication was inconclusive because tumors arose rapidly in controls. Later independent PREX2 work produced useful results in HCC, which must not be mistaken for validation of the specific melanoma alleles.
